heading: Winter Festivals & Events in the Okanagan, January–March 2027
title: Okanagan Winter Events, Jan–Mar 2027 | Okanagan Roam
description: Frost Fest in Penticton, a Polar Bear Dip, a ski race, a chef dinner, ballet and Come From Away across the Okanagan, Jan–Mar 2027.
intro: This guide covers the winter 2027 season, from New Year's Day to the end of March. It's a short list: our winter listings are mostly theatre nights and single concerts, so the picks below are the events that stand out, from a winter carnival in Penticton and a Polar Bear Dip on New Year's Day to a ski race, a chef dinner and ballet. Dates and details can change, so check each event page before you go.
Events are grouped by type. Each one shows its town and date.
